| `World:PacketHeuristics:CadenceLimits:EmotePerSecond` | `int` | `5` | - | CMSG_EMOTE and CMSG_TEXT_EMOTE per second. 0-1000, default 5. |
| `World:PacketHeuristics:CadenceLimits:PingMinIntervalMs` | `int` | `5000` | - | A CMSG_PING that follows the previous one by less than this many milliseconds is reported (a 1.12.1 client pings every 30 seconds). 0 switches it off. 0-60000, default 5000. |
| `World:PacketHeuristics:CadenceLimits:QueryPerSecond` | `int` | `50` | - | Query opcodes (names containing QUERY) per second. A client entering a crowded city can burst; raise it if that is all you see. 0-1000, default 50. |
| `World:PacketHeuristics:CadenceLimits:UsePerSecond` | `int` | `10` | - | CMSG_USE_ITEM, CMSG_GAMEOBJ_USE and CMSG_LOOT per second. 0-1000, default 10. |
| `World:PacketHeuristics:DevOpcode` | `bool` | `true` | - | Report a stripped developer, GM, cheat or debug opcode that the release client never sends (`dev-opcode`); the packet is dropped unread either way. Default true. |
| `World:PacketHeuristics:Enabled` | `bool` | `false` | - | Run the checks at all. Default false: with it off a packet costs one volatile read and no per-session state exists. |
| `World:PacketHeuristics:ExemptBots` | `bool` | `true` | - | The server's own managed playerbot sessions are not checked. Default true; with false their traffic is checked and counted as bot traffic. |
| `World:PacketHeuristics:ExemptStaff` | `bool` | `true` | - | Staff (Moderator and above, or a player in GM mode) are not checked. Default true; with false their traffic is checked and counted as staff traffic. |
| `World:PacketHeuristics:IncapacitatedAction` | `bool` | `true` | - | Report an action opcode received while the player is dead or a ghost, on a taxi flight or in a far transfer (`incapacitated-action`; a near teleport such as Blink is not one). Default true. |
| `World:PacketHeuristics:Malformed` | `bool` | `true` | - | Report a payload a handler rejected as malformed, or a bad frame header (`malformed`). Default true. |
| `World:PacketHeuristics:OrphanAck` | `bool` | `true` | - | Report an unsolicited or mismatching movement acknowledgement (`orphan-ack`). Default true. |
| `World:PacketHeuristics:Replay` | `bool` | `true` | - | Report the same opcode with the same payload repeated (`replay`). Default true. |
| `World:PacketHeuristics:ReplayBuiltInExclusions` | `bool` | `true` | - | Keep the built-in list of opcodes that legitimately repeat an identical payload out of the replay check: movement and its acknowledgements, ping, every query, selection and attack toggles, cancels, stand state, loot release, area triggers, character enumeration and the polling a client or bot does (docs/areas/packet-heuristics.md has the list and the reason for each entry). Default true; set false to take full control with `ReplayExclude`. |
| `World:PacketHeuristics:ReplayCount` | `int` | `5` | - | The same opcode and payload this many times within `ReplayWindowMs` is a replay. 2-1000, default 5. |
| `World:PacketHeuristics:ReplayExclude` | `string[]` | `[]` | - | More opcodes never checked for replay, on top of the built-in list: exact opcode names (CMSG_PING) or names with a leading and/or trailing * (MSG_MOVE_*, *QUERY*). A configured list is added to the default (empty) one, so entries never remove anything; use `ReplayBuiltInExclusions` to drop the built-in list. Default empty. |
| `World:PacketHeuristics:ReplayWindowMs` | `int` | `1000` | - | The window of the replay check, in milliseconds. 100-60000, default 1000. |
| `World:PacketHeuristics:ReportIntervalSeconds` | `int` | `10` | - | At most one ledger report per session, check and opcode per this many seconds; every occurrence is still counted. 1-3600, default 10. |
| `World:PacketHeuristics:Shape` | `bool` | `true` | - | Report a payload whose length differs from the fixed length of its message (`shape`). Default true. |
| `World:PacketHeuristics:UnknownOpcode` | `bool` | `true` | - | Report an opcode with no handler or outside the opcode table (`unknown-opcode`). Default true. |
| `World:PacketHeuristics:WrongState` | `bool` | `true` | - | Report an opcode dropped because the session state does not allow it (`wrong-state`). Default true. |
| `World:PacketHeuristics:WrongStateGraceMs` | `int` | `5000` | - | After the player left the world (logout, back at the character screen) world opcodes are expected for this many milliseconds (packets in flight) and are not reported as `wrong-state`. Only this post-logout window is timed: a map-less player in a far teleport is excused by the teleport stage, however long the loading screen takes. 0-60000, default 5000. |

## `World:Playerbots`

| Key | Type | Default | Reload | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `World:Playerbots:AllowedMaps` | `uint[]` | `[0, 1]` | - | The maps bots may act and travel on (non-empty, no duplicates; a configured list replaces the default continents 0 and 1). |
| `World:Playerbots:AsyncNavigationEnabled` | `bool` | `false` | restart | Run far playerbot navigation queries on the bounded private worker (off by default during rollout). Restart required: the worker is created when the feature attaches. |
| `World:Playerbots:Battlegrounds:Enabled` | `bool` | `true` | live | Let free bots queue for battlegrounds (on by default). Off: no bot starts a queue; bots already walking to a battlemaster, queued or in a match finish. |
| `World:Playerbots:Battlegrounds:MaxBotsPerBattleground` | `int` | `20` | live | The most bots in one battleground (0..80; 0 queues none). Bots waiting for one battleground type and level bracket never exceed it, a team never gets more than half of it (rounded up) and a bot declines an invitation into a match that already holds this many. |
| `World:Playerbots:Battlegrounds:MaxQueueWaitMinutes` | `int` | `30` | live | Minutes a bot waits in a queue before it leaves it (1..240); it then does not queue for that type again for 10 minutes. |
| `World:Playerbots:Battlegrounds:MaxTravelYards` | `int` | `1500` | live | The farthest, in yards, a battlemaster may stand from a bot for the bot to walk to it (100..20000): a straight line on the bot's own map, to a battlemaster whose faction is not hostile to the bot. |
| `World:Playerbots:Battlegrounds:PreferFillingRealPlayerQueues` | `bool` | `true` | live | Let bots fill the queues real players wait in, so their games start (on by default): a bracket with a real player waiting gets bots at once (no chance roll) up to the minimum both teams need, and they pick the type and bracket the player waits for. |
| `World:Playerbots:Battlegrounds:QueueChancePerMinute` | `float` | `0.05` | live | The chance, per minute, that a free bot of a fitting level starts to queue (0..1; 0 never, 1 at the next scan). The chance of one scan is `1 - (1 - p)^(scanSeconds / 60)`, so the rate does not depend on how often the coordinator looks. |
| `World:Playerbots:Budget:ClassLevelsAhead` | `int` | `2` | live | How many levels ahead of its own the bot saves for class spells (0..10): the spells its class trainer teaches at levels up to this many above the bot's, plus the ones it can learn now, are reserved at the trainer's prices, so lower-priority spending (riding, the auction house) cannot eat the money they cost. 0 reserves only what can be learned now. |
| `World:Playerbots:Budget:DiscretionaryFloorFraction` | `float` | `0.1` | live | The share of its current money (0..1) a bot may always spend on discretionary purchases (auction upgrades), even when the reserves leave nothing over: a reserve the bot may never reach (a tier far above its means) does not stop its optional buying for good. 0 lets the reserves take everything. Auction listing deposits are never limited by the reserves. |
| `World:Playerbots:Budget:Enabled` | `bool` | `true` | live | Let bots save for what they will need (on by default). Off: nothing is reserved and every spend site may spend all the bot's money. |
| `World:Playerbots:Budget:EssentialsAllowanceCopper` | `uint` | `10000` | live | Copper a bot may always spend on food, drink and ammunition (0..100000000), whatever it saves for: the part of a purchase that the reserves would otherwise forbid is allowed up to this price, so a saving bot never starves. |
| `World:Playerbots:Budget:RefreshSeconds` | `int` | `30` | live | Seconds between two recomputations of a bot's reserves (1..3600); a level, a learned spell or a new map recompute them at once. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chaos:ActiveChaosBots` | `int` | `4` | live | How many running autonomous bots are automatically selected as chaos bots when `Enabled` is on (0..5000, default 4). Bots explicitly assigned with `.playerbot chaos assign` always run probes while `Enabled` is on, even when this is 0. Live through `.reload config`. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chaos:BoundaryMovement` | `bool` | `true` | live | Include movement packets with extreme orientations, boundary flags, rapid start/stop/jump/heartbeat transitions and invalid spline or transport fields (on by default). Any non-finite coordinate is rolled back if a handler fails to reject it, and a fault is recorded. Live through `.reload config`. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chaos:Enabled` | `bool` | `false` | live | Run adversarial chaos probes on designated running playerbots (off by default). Live through `.reload config` and `.playerbot chaos on\|off`. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chaos:MalformedPayloads` | `bool` | `true` | live | Include truncated, zero-length, oversized and random-byte malformed wire payloads across registered world opcodes (on by default). Clean `MalformedPacket` rejections are counted as expected; any other exception is recorded as a server fault. Live through `.reload config`. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chaos:ProbesPerThink` | `int` | `2` | live | How many adversarial packet/state probes each active chaos bot executes per think (1..16, default 2). Live through `.reload config`. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chaos:Seed` | `int` | `0` | live | Deterministic PRNG seed for chaos probe selection and payload generation (0 uses a time-seeded sequence; any non-zero value replays the same sequence per bot; -2147483648..2147483647). Live through `.reload config`. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chaos:StateRaces` | `bool` | `true` | live | Include out-of-order state-machine race probes: resurrection/release while alive or dead, double loot/release, self-target and stale-GUID combat/spell/trade/vendor/quest/guild/group/mail/auction/battleground packets, and inventory slot boundary swaps (on by default). Live through `.reload config`. |
| `World:Playerbots:ChaseReplanYards` | `float` | `5` | - | How far (flat yards, 0.5..100) the target of a chase may move from the place the chase route was planned to before the route is planned again, in the same think that sees it. A route cut short of its target by the route bounds (`MaxRouteYards`, `MaxPathPoints`) is planned again only once the bot has walked 75% of it. A chase route walked to its end is planned again at once, whatever this says. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Channels` | `PlayerbotChatChannels` | `All` | live | The lines a bot answers: `Whisper`, `Party`, `Say`, `Yell`, `Raid`, `Battleground`, `Guild` and `World` (comma-separated; all of them by default). A reply goes back on the channel the line came on. Values: `None`, `Whisper`, `Party`, `Say`, `Yell`, `Raid`, `Battleground`, `Guild`, `World`, `All`. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Conversation:BotCooldownMinutes` | `int` | `10` | live | Minutes before one bot starts or joins another conversation (1..1440). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Conversation:CandidatesPerPass` | `int` | `8` | live | How many bots the director looks at per pass when it picks a conversation (1..256): the work per pass is bounded by it, whatever the size of the fleet. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Conversation:ConversationsPerHour` | `int` | `20` | live | The most conversations the director starts in an hour, over all bots (0..600; 0 = none). Each pass rolls against this, so they spread over the hour instead of coming in bursts. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Conversation:Enabled` | `bool` | `true` | live | Let the director start bot-to-bot conversations (on by default; needs `PlayerbotSpeechOptions.BotToBot`). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Conversation:LineDeadlineSeconds` | `int` | `60` | live | How long a planned line may wait for the speech limits before the conversation is dropped (10..600 seconds). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Conversation:LineGapSeconds` | `int` | `7` | live | The least seconds between two lines of a conversation (2..120): the time a player takes to read and type. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Conversation:LineJitterSeconds` | `int` | `6` | live | The most extra random seconds added to `LineGapSeconds` (0..120). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Conversation:MaxActive` | `int` | `4` | live | The most conversations running at once (1..64). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Conversation:MaxHeardQueue` | `int` | `64` | live | Heard world channel lines waiting for the next social pass at most (8..1024); more are dropped. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Conversation:MaxLines` | `int` | `4` | live | The most lines one conversation has, the opener included (2..6). The bot-to-bot turn cap (`PlayerbotSpeechOptions.BotToBotMaxTurns`) still applies to the answers, so with its default of 3 a conversation has at most 4 lines. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Conversation:NearYards` | `int` | `20` | live | Two bots "near each other" are at most this many yards apart (5..100) for a /say conversation. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Conversation:PairCooldownMinutes` | `int` | `30` | live | Minutes before the same two bots are paired again (1..1440). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Conversation:ReactionPlayerCooldownMinutes` | `int` | `10` | live | Minutes before one bot reacts to the same player's world channel lines again (1..1440). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Conversation:ReactionsPerLine` | `int` | `1` | live | How many bots answer one world channel line at most (1..5). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Conversation:WorldReactions` | `bool` | `true` | live | Answer a real player's world channel line that fits the bot: an LFM for a dungeon at the bot's level (a whispered "inv" when the bot is free and its role is wanted), a WTB for an item the bot carries spare (a whispered offer) (on by default). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Conversation:WorldReactionsPerMinute` | `int` | `4` | live | The most reactions all bots together whisper in a minute (0..60; 0 = none). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Enabled` | `bool` | `true` | live | Let bots answer players' chat (on by default, with the built-in templates only). Off: the fixed replies of before. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:InProcess:AmbientQueueMs` | `int` | `4000` | - | How long a line no one is waiting on (guild chatter, announcements) may wait for a free slot before it is dropped (250..60000 ms): stale small talk is not worth writing. A player's line is never dropped this way. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:InProcess:BudgetMs` | `int` | `6000` | - | The hard budget of one reply, prompt included, in wall-clock milliseconds (250..60000); a reply not done by then is dropped and the templates answer. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:InProcess:CircuitBreakerOverruns` | `int` | `3` | - | Budget overruns in a row that open the circuit (1..100): the model then rests for `CircuitBreakerSeconds` and the templates answer. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:InProcess:CircuitBreakerSeconds` | `int` | `300` | - | How long an open circuit keeps the model out (10..3600 seconds). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:InProcess:ContextTokens` | `int` | `1024` | - | The context window per slot in tokens (256..32768; capped at the model's own): the prompt and the reply must fit. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:InProcess:MaxConcurrent` | `int` | `1` | - | Replies written at once (1..4); each has its own threads and cache. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:InProcess:MaxNewTokens` | `int` | `48` | - | The most tokens of one reply (8..256). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:InProcess:MaxQueued` | `int` | `2` | - | Replies that may wait for a free slot beyond the running ones (0..64); past it the templates answer. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:InProcess:MaxReplyCharacters` | `int` | `160` | - | The longest reply said (40..255 characters); a longer one is dropped and the templates answer. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:InProcess:MinP` | `double` | `0.05` | - | Drop tokens less likely than this fraction of the most likely one (0..1; 0 = off). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:InProcess:ModelPath` | `string` | `""` | - | The model file (GGUF, llama or qwen2 architecture, gpt2 BPE tokenizer; relative to the content root, or absolute), e.g. `models/chat/SmolLM2-360M-Instruct-Q8_0.gguf`. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:InProcess:PrefillChunkTokens` | `int` | `64` | - | Prompt tokens one reply computes per scheduler step (32..512): smaller lets a player's line overtake a long prompt sooner. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:InProcess:PrefixCacheTokens` | `int` | `1024` | - | Prompt tokens kept in the shared prefix cache (0..16384; 0 = off): the keys and values of the fixed system rules every bot prompt starts with (and recent conversations) are computed once and copied into whichever slot a reply runs on. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:InProcess:RepetitionPenalty` | `double` | `1.15` | - | The penalty on tokens already in the recent text (1..2; 1 = none). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:InProcess:RepetitionWindow` | `int` | `64` | - | How many of the latest tokens (prompt and reply) `RepetitionPenalty` looks at (0..1024; 0 = none). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:InProcess:Seed` | `int?` | `null` | - | A fixed seed makes the same prompt give the same reply (unset: a fresh draw each time). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:InProcess:StopSequences` | `List<string>` | `[]` | - | Text that ends a reply where it appears (the text itself is not said), e.g. `"User:"`; at most 8, each 1..32 characters. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:InProcess:Temperature` | `double` | `0.7` | - | Sampling temperature (0..2; 0 = always the most likely token). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:InProcess:Threads` | `int` | `2` | - | Threads one reply computes on (1..16; dedicated, BelowNormal priority, never the thread pool). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:InProcess:TopK` | `int` | `40` | - | Sample among the k most likely tokens (1..256). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:InProcess:TopP` | `double` | `0.9` | - | Then among the smallest set holding this much probability (0.05..1). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:MaxDailySpendUsd` | `double` | `1` | live | The most estimated US dollars the priced providers may spend per UTC day (0..10000; 0 = no daily cap). The estimate counts the tokens each reply reports at the provider's price; a provider without a known price is limited by its MaxRepliesPerHour only. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:MaxQueuedRequests` | `int` | `16` | live | The most replies waiting for a provider at once (1..256); a line that finds the queue full is not answered. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:MemoryExchanges` | `int` | `4` | live | Earlier exchanges with the same player a bot remembers and sends with a model request (0..16). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:NaturalLanguageCommands` | `bool` | `true` | live | Let the party master's plain-language orders ("follow me", "wait here", "attack my target") drive the party commands (on by default). Only the master's lines are read for orders; the one-word commands work either way. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:PerPlayerCooldownSeconds` | `int` | `8` | live | Seconds after a reply before the same player gets another one from any bot (0..3600; lines in between are not answered). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Providers` | `PlayerbotChatProviderOptions[]` | `[]` | live | The reply providers, tried in order until one answers (failover on an error, a timeout, a 429, a spent budget or a missing key). Empty by default: only the built-in templates answer. The built-in provider is appended when it is not listed, and when listed it must be last. See docs/areas/playbots.md for the provider keys (Kind, BaseUrl, Model, ApiKeyEnvironmentVariable, Headers, MaxRepliesPerHour, MaxTokens, TokenLimitParameter, ReasoningEffort, JsonResponseFormat, InputUsdPerMillionTokens, OutputUsdPerMillionTokens, Moderation, ModerationBaseUrl, ModerationModel, ModerationApiKeyEnvironmentVariable). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Safety:AllowOptOut` | `bool` | `true` | live | Let a player whisper a bot "ai off" (built-in replies only) or "ai on" (on). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Safety:AutoMute` | `bool` | `false` | live | Also mute a player's chat (the account mute of `.mute`) when they are cut off (off). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Safety:AutoMuteMinutes` | `int` | `30` | live | The automatic mute's length in minutes (1..10080). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Safety:Categories` | `PlayerbotChatSafetyCategories` | `All` | live | The local filter's categories (comma-separated; all by default): SexualMinors, SelfHarm, Threats, Hate, Harassment, IllegalGoods, PersonalData. Values: `None`, `SexualMinors`, `SelfHarm`, `Threats`, `Hate`, `Harassment`, `IllegalGoods`, `PersonalData`, `All`. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Safety:CutoffMinutes` | `int` | `60` | live | Minutes a cut-off player gets built-in replies only (1..10080). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Safety:Disclosure` | `bool` | `true` | live | Tell each player once per login, the first time they talk to a bot, that bot replies may come from an AI service (on; only while a model provider is configured). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Safety:DisclosureText` | `string` | `"Bot replies on this server may be written by an AI service, which receives what you say to bots."` | live | The disclosure (1..200 characters, one line, no '\|'); the opt-out or opt-in hint is added after it. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Safety:Enabled` | `bool` | `true` | live | Screen every player line before any model provider sees it (the local filter, then each provider's optional moderation step), and every model reply before a bot says it (`ScreenOutput`). On by default. A flagged line never reaches a model. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Safety:FlagLogSize` | `int` | `200` | live | Flag records kept in memory for `.playerbot chat flags` (0..10000; the oldest go first). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Safety:OnFlagged` | `PlayerbotChatFlaggedAction` | `BuiltinReply` | live | What a flagged player line gets: `BuiltinReply` (default) or `Ignore`. Values: `BuiltinReply`, `Ignore`. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Safety:OnOutputFlagged` | `PlayerbotChatOutputAction` | `BuiltinReply` | live | What replaces a flagged model reply: `BuiltinReply` (default) or `Drop`. Values: `BuiltinReply`, `Drop`. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Safety:ReplaceDefaultTerms` | `bool` | `false` | live | Use only `TermsFile`'s lists, not the shipped ones (off). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Safety:RequireOptIn` | `bool` | `false` | live | Use the model providers only for players who whispered a bot "ai on" (off). Everyone else gets built-in replies. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Safety:ScreenOutput` | `bool` | `true` | live | Screen each model reply with the local filter before the bot says it (on). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Safety:StoreExcerpt` | `bool` | `true` | live | Keep a short excerpt of each flagged line (at most 60 characters, emails, phone numbers and addresses removed) in the flag record and the log warning (on). Off: only who, when, which bot and which category. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Safety:StrikeWindowMinutes` | `int` | `60` | live | Minutes a strike counts (1..10080); older strikes fall away. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Safety:StrikesBeforeCutoff` | `int` | `3` | live | Strikes within `StrikeWindowMinutes` that cut a player off from the model providers (1..100). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Safety:StripPersonalData` | `bool` | `true` | live | Replace emails, phone numbers and street addresses in what is sent to a model provider with a placeholder (on). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Safety:TermsFile` | `string` | `""` | live | An operator's term file (the shipped file's JSON format), relative to the working directory or absolute. Empty: only the shipped list. Its entries are added to the shipped ones unless `ReplaceDefaultTerms`; it is read again when it changes. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Speech:BotGapSeconds` | `int` | `20` | live | The least seconds between two lines a bot starts on its own (0..3600; replies are not held by it). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Speech:BotLinesPerMinute` | `int` | `6` | live | The most lines one bot says in a minute, replies included (1..60). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Speech:BotToBot` | `bool` | `true` | live | Let a bot's line reach other bots as input (on by default), within `BotToBotMaxTurns`, `BotToBotPairLinesPerHour` and `BotToBotLinesPerMinute`. Off: bots hear only real players, as before. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Speech:BotToBotLinesPerMinute` | `int` | `10` | live | The most lines all bots together say to other bots in a minute (0..600). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Speech:BotToBotMaxTurns` | `int` | `3` | live | The most answers in one exchange between two bots (0..10; 0 = bots never answer bots). An exchange ends after `BotToBotQuietSeconds` of silence between them. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Speech:BotToBotPairLinesPerHour` | `int` | `12` | live | The most lines two bots say to each other in an hour (0..600). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Speech:BotToBotQuietSeconds` | `int` | `120` | live | Seconds of silence after which an exchange between two bots is over and its turns start again (10..3600). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Speech:ChannelChangesPerPass` | `int` | `25` | live | The most bots whose channels are changed in one social pass (1..1000), so a fleet logging in at once spreads its joins. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Speech:ChannelCrowdBots` | `int` | `10` | live | How many bots a world channel holds before its budget thins out (1..10000; see `ChannelLinesPerMinute`). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Speech:ChannelLinesPerMinute` | `int` | `3` | live | The most bot lines one world channel hears in a minute, from all bots together (0..60; 0 keeps bots silent there). The channel is per zone ("General - Elwynn Forest") and per faction; when more than `ChannelCrowdBots` bots are in it the minute stretches in proportion, so a crowded channel hears fewer bot lines, never more. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Speech:DedupeSeconds` | `int` | `120` | live | Seconds within which the same line is not said twice in the same place by any bot (0..3600). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Speech:EmoteReplies` | `bool` | `true` | live | Answer a text emote a player (or bot) aims at a bot in kind: a wave with a wave, a bow with a bow, a hug with a blush, a rude gesture with one back or nothing (on by default), at most once per `EmoteReplyGapSeconds` per bot and emoter. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Speech:EmoteReplyGapSeconds` | `int` | `30` | live | The least seconds between two emote answers from one bot to the same emoter (0..3600). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Speech:Enabled` | `bool` | `true` | live | Let bots speak through the speech API (on by default). Off: only the answers of the chat service of before (whisper, party, say). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Speech:GroupLinesPerMinute` | `int` | `8` | live | The most lines the bots of one party, raid or battleground team say in a minute (0..120). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Speech:GuildLinesPerMinute` | `int` | `4` | live | The most lines the bots of one guild say in guild chat in a minute (0..120; the guild announcements keep their own hourly cap too). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Speech:LocalLinesPerMinute` | `int` | `6` | live | The most /say and /yell lines bots say in a minute in one zone of one map, from all bots together (0..120). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Speech:MaxQueuedLines` | `int` | `512` | live | Lines waiting for the world thread at once (16..4096); a line that finds the queue full is not said. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Speech:RequireRealListener` | `bool` | `true` | live | A line a bot starts on its own (not a reply) is said only where a real (non-bot) player can hear it: someone in say or yell range, a real member of the group or guild online, a real member of the world channel, an online whisper target (on by default). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Speech:TargetGapSeconds` | `int` | `10` | live | The least seconds between two lines from one bot to the same player (whisper, emote or reply; 0..3600; a high-priority reply is not held). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Speech:WorldChannels` | `PlayerbotWorldChannels` | `All` | live | The zone channels bots join through their own CMSG_JOIN_CHANNEL on login and when they change zone, leaving the old zone's ones (`General`, `Trade`, `LocalDefense`, `LookingForGroup`; comma-separated; all by default; `None` joins none and leaves the ones joined). Names and rules are the 1.12 client's: General and LocalDefense in every open-world zone, Trade only in a capital, LookingForGroup everywhere; none of the zone ones inside an instance or battleground. Values: `None`, `General`, `Trade`, `LocalDefense`, `LookingForGroup`, `All`. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:TimeoutSeconds` | `int` | `10` | live | Seconds one model request may take before the next provider is tried (1..60). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Voice:AnswerPosts` | `bool` | `true` | live | Answer a real player's whisper to a poster ("inv" to an LFG or LFM call, a price question to a WTS call) here (on by default). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Voice:BattlegroundCallSeconds` | `int` | `20` | live | Seconds within which one battleground callout (the same event or the same carrier's whereabouts) is not said again (5..600). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Voice:BattlegroundCalls` | `bool` | `true` | live | Battleground callouts in battleground chat from the match's real state (on by default): Warsong Gulch "our flag taken" and "EFC &lt;where&gt;", Arathi Basin "inc &lt;base&gt;", "&lt;base&gt; is ours", "lost &lt;base&gt;", Alterac Valley towers and graveyards. One bot says each event; the same callout is not repeated within `BattlegroundCallSeconds`. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Voice:BotsPerPass` | `int` | `24` | live | The most bots whose state is looked at in one social pass (1..1000), round robin over the running bots. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Voice:Enabled` | `bool` | `true` | live | Let bots voice their goals and needs (on by default). Off: no topic is produced and no LFG or trade whisper is answered here. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Voice:GeneralSharePercent` | `int` | `25` | live | The share of LFG and trade calls said in General instead (LFG outside a capital, trade outside a capital; 0..100). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Voice:GroupCalls` | `bool` | `true` | live | Party and raid needs (on by default), each once per fight, death or stop: "oom" (a mana user below 10% in a fight), "need heals" (below 30% with a healer in the group), "rez pls" (dead, a resurrecting class alive in the group), "inc &lt;n&gt;" (a bot group's tank pulling more than one), "&lt;mob&gt; on me" (a creature on a bot that is not the tank), "brb" (the bot stops to drink, vendor or train), "ty" (after a resurrection or a long buff from a group member), "ding" (a level up), "gz" (a real player's "ding"), a quest share request in a bot group, and "first time here" (a zone the bot had never explored). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Voice:LinesPerPass` | `int` | `4` | live | The most lines the voice hands to the chat service in one social pass, every topic together (1..100). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Voice:LookingForGroup` | `bool` | `true` | live | LFG and LFM calls (on by default): a bot waiting for partners for a dungeon, raid or elite quest posts "LFG &lt;dungeon&gt;, &lt;lvl&gt; &lt;class&gt;" (alone) or "LFM &lt;dungeon&gt; need &lt;role&gt;" (the oldest of several waiting for the same goal) in LookingForGroup, or now and then in General (`GeneralSharePercent`); a real player who whispers the poster "inv" is matched into the group. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Voice:LookingForGroupRepeatSeconds` | `int` | `180` | live | The least seconds between two LFG or LFM calls of one bot (30..3600). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Voice:MinSellCopper` | `int` | `200` | live | Items worth less than this many copper at a vendor (per stack) are not offered (0..1000000). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Voice:PostLifeSeconds` | `int` | `600` | live | How long a call stays open for whispered answers (60..3600 seconds). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Voice:PriceMultiplier` | `int` | `4` | live | A WTS price is the item's vendor price times this (1..50), rounded the way players price. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Voice:QuestHelp` | `bool` | `true` | live | Quest help (on by default): a bot waiting for partners for an elite or group quest asks General now and then ("anyone for &lt;quest&gt;?") at most once per `QuestHelpRepeatSeconds`. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Voice:QuestHelpRepeatSeconds` | `int` | `1200` | live | The least seconds between two quest help calls of one bot (60..86400). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Voice:RunCalls` | `bool` | `true` | live | The bot that leads a dungeon or raid run says the plan in party or raid chat: "pulling &lt;boss&gt;", "wait for mana", "wipe, run back", "gg" (on by default). |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Voice:Trade` | `bool` | `true` | live | Trade calls (on by default): WTS for tradeable surplus in the bot's bags (no grey, no bind-on-pickup or bound item, no quest item, nothing it would wear itself) at `PriceMultiplier` times the vendor price, and WTB for the reagents of the recipes it wants; in Trade in a capital, now and then in General elsewhere (`GeneralSharePercent`). A real player who whispers the seller about the item is told the price and where the bot is. |
| `World:Playerbots:Chat:Voice:TradeRepeatSeconds` | `int` | `900` | live | The least seconds between two trade calls of one bot (60..86400). |
| `World:Playerbots:ClientFidelity` | `PlayerbotClientFidelity` | `Lean` | - | How much real-client packet work a bot's session does (`PlayerbotClientFidelity.Lean` by default). Lean: a bot has no client, so the map builds no SMSG_UPDATE_OBJECT blocks for it (its visible set is still maintained) and its session keeps only the received packets a bot reads back (`PlayerbotPacketIntake`). Full: bots are treated like real clients, every packet is built, compressed and copied into the bot's receive ring, which is the stress-test mode for load testing. A session with an observer attached (scenario, packet capture) always receives everything. Read at start; a restart applies a change. Values: `Lean`, `Full`. |
| `World:Playerbots:Combat:Kite:Enabled` | `bool` | `true` | live | Kite at all (on by default). |
| `World:Playerbots:Combat:Kite:HealthPct` | `float` | `50` | live | A bot kites once its health falls to this percentage (10..95). |
| `World:Playerbots:Combat:Kite:MaxStepsPerFight` | `int` | `8` | live | Steps one fight may use before the bot stops kiting and fights on (1..32). |
| `World:Playerbots:Combat:Kite:StepYards` | `float` | `10` | live | The longest single step away from the pursuer, in yards (4..20). |
| `World:Playerbots:CombatLaneShare` | `double` | `0.7` | - | The share (0.1..0.9) of the think time budget and of `MaxActionsPerTick` the combat lane may use. The lane gets floor(share × `MaxActionsPerTick`) actions of its own (none at `MaxActionsPerTick` 1); the rest, at least one, is the other bots' and no fight's think can touch it, so they are never starved by a crowd of fights. What the combat lane leaves goes to the other bots too. |
| `World:Playerbots:CombatThinkIntervalMs` | `int` | `300` | - | Milliseconds (50..60000) after which a bot that is in combat, dead or a ghost is due for the think lane that comes first (`PlayerbotThinkRotation.TickLanes`). Under load such a bot thinks about this often; with room for everyone every bot thinks every tick as before. |
| `World:Playerbots:Contention:ClaimPenaltyYards` | `float` | `25` | live | Yards a mob counts as farther away for each other bot already walking to it (0..200), when a bot picks among untagged mobs. 0 turns the soft claims off, so every bot goes for the nearest mob again. |
| `World:Playerbots:Contention:ContentionSuspendMinutes` | `int` | `5` | live | Minutes a bot leaves a quest creature alone after three minutes of contested hunting without credit (1..120; see `PlayerbotContention.ObserveObjective`): it hunts its next unfinished objective or quest meanwhile, and asks for a group when none is left. |
| `World:Playerbots:Contention:HelpChance` | `float` | `0.35` | live | Base chance (0..1) that a bot walking to a mob another player has tagged decides to help that player instead of leaving the mob alone. It is scaled by the bot's own sociability (a stable 0..1 from its guid), doubled for a real player's tag and raised by half when both share the kill quest, and only asked when the tagger is within 30 yards and losing and the bot is healthy. 0 never helps. |
| `World:Playerbots:Contention:InvincibleTargetAbandonSeconds` | `int` | `8` | live | Seconds a bot may hold a target whose health stays at or below its death-prevention threshold (`InvincibilityHpThreshold`: a creature an EventAI script keeps at 1 health until some condition is met, such as the Blasted Lands servants of quest 2681) before it sets the creature aside as one it cannot kill (1..600). |
| `World:Playerbots:Contention:SomeoneElsesMemorySeconds` | `int` | `15` | live | Seconds a bot leaves a mob alone after it found it to be someone else's (1..600), and the least between two decisions about the same mob. |
| `World:Playerbots:CornerCentringMaxYards` | `float` | `4` | - | The most (yards, 0..10) the centring part of a `PathShaping` move can be: a corner in a corridor bounded on both sides (a road between two walls) is pushed away from the inside of the turn by the larger of the clearance still missing and its way to the middle of the corridor, and this caps that way to the middle only, so it never lowers the clearance push. 0 turns road centring off. A corner is never moved closer than 0.5 yard to the far side. |
| `World:Playerbots:CornerClearanceYards` | `float` | `2` | - | The clearance (yards, 0.5..5) kept from the obstacle on the inside of a turn when `PathShaping` moves a route corner. The navigation mesh is built with a 0.2 yard agent radius, so an unshaped corner sits that close to the wall or post it goes around. |
| `World:Playerbots:CornerTurnLeadYards` | `float` | `2.5` | - | How far before a corner (yards, 0..6) `PathShaping` starts to turn it: the tangent length of the arc that rounds a turn sharper than about 34 degrees. 0 turns rounding off; the lead is also held to 40% of the shorter leg beside the corner. |
| `World:Playerbots:CutRegionMaxPolygons` | `int` | `5000` | - | The most polygons a cut region (a navigation region that is the only way between two large parts of the mesh, such as the Timbermaw Hold tunnel) may hold and still be exempt from shared world pins and from refusing a bot's pinned plan end (0..1000000; 0: no region is exempt). The exemption judges the whole region, so a larger bound lets more real snags go unshared. The default, 5000, keeps the Timbermaw Hold tunnel's largest measured region inside it, with about 2% headroom; re-check after regenerating mmaps. Bots only; no retail behaviour depends on it. |
| `World:Playerbots:Economy:BankDeposit` | `bool` | `true` | live | Deposit goods the bot does not need (trade goods and reagents no spell of its own uses, gems, recipes, stackable curios) at a banker while it stays at its capital home (on by default). Gear, food, potions, ammunition, bags, grays and quest items are never deposited. |
| `World:Playerbots:Economy:BuyBankSlots` | `bool` | `true` | live | Buy the next bank bag slot at a banker while the bot stays at its capital home when the bank has fewer than 5 free slots and the price is at most 40% of the bot's gold (on by default). A bought slot is only space once a bag is put in it, which bots do not do yet, so the bank-nearly-full gate keeps the purchase rare. |
| `World:Playerbots:Economy:BuyBelowAskPercent` | `int` | `50` | live | The most a bot pays per unit at the house (reagents and gear) as a percent of the bot floor of that item, so no bot ever pays what a bot asks. |
| `World:Playerbots:Economy:BuyReagents` | `bool` | `true` | live | Buy the reagents of the recipes the bot wants to craft that it carries fewer of than one craft uses at the faction auction house during a visit (on by default): at most 2 auctions a visit, within the visit budget. Guards: a reagent a vendor stocks is never bought; an auction holds at most twice the shortfall; a buyout per unit is at most `BuyBelowAskPercent` percent of the bot floor of the item (an item with no vendor sell price is never bought). Off: no reagent is searched or bought. Reagents a wanted recipe uses are never listed either way. |
| `World:Playerbots:Economy:BuyUpgradeBudgetFraction` | `float` | `0.25` | live | The share of the money a bot holds at the start of a visit that the visit may spend in all (0..1): listing deposits and the buyout of an upgrade count against it. 0 spends nothing. |
| `World:Playerbots:Economy:ConsumableKeepCount` | `int` | `20` | live | Per consumable entry, the count (1..200) a bot always keeps before a stack of it is surplus. |
| `World:Playerbots:Economy:Enabled` | `bool` | `true` | live | Let bots list, buy and collect at the auction house (on by default). Off: no visit starts; a running one is dropped. |
| `World:Playerbots:Economy:HouseBuyoutsPerHour` | `int` | `200` | live | The most auctions all bots together buy out at one auction house in any 60 minutes of world time (0..100000); 0 lets no bot buy there. A soft limit: a buyout counts when the house confirms it, so bots with buyouts in flight together can overshoot it by their number. |
| `World:Playerbots:Economy:HouseListingsPerHour` | `int` | `400` | live | The most auctions all bots together list at one auction house in any 60 minutes of world time (0..100000); 0 lets no bot list there. A soft limit: a listing counts when the house confirms it, so bots with listings in flight together can overshoot it by their number. |
| `World:Playerbots:Economy:ListChancePerVisit` | `int` | `50` | live | The chance in percent (0..100) that a visit lists anything: one roll per visit, then the bot lists up to its free listing slots. 0 lists nothing (a bot may still buy and collect); 100 always lists. |
| `World:Playerbots:Economy:ListMarkupPercentCommon` | `int` | `500` | live | The bot floor of a common (white) item as a percent of its vendor sell price (never below the reference price or the vendor floor after the cut). |
| `World:Playerbots:Economy:ListMarkupPercentEpic` | `int` | `10000` | live | The bot floor of an epic or better item as a percent of its vendor sell price (never below the reference price or the vendor floor after the cut). |
| `World:Playerbots:Economy:ListMarkupPercentRare` | `int` | `800` | live | The bot floor of a rare (blue) item as a percent of its vendor sell price (never below the reference price or the vendor floor after the cut). |
| `World:Playerbots:Economy:ListMarkupPercentUncommon` | `int` | `300` | live | The bot floor of an uncommon (green) item as a percent of its vendor sell price (never below the reference price or the vendor floor after the cut). |
| `World:Playerbots:Economy:ListSurplusConsumables` | `bool` | `true` | live | List stacks of consumables (food, drink, potions, bandages, elixirs, scrolls) beyond the keep count (on by default). |
| `World:Playerbots:Economy:MaxBuyoutsPerHour` | `int` | `6` | live | The most auctions one bot buys out, reagents and upgrades together, in any 60 minutes of world time (0..100); 0 buys nothing. |
| `World:Playerbots:Economy:MaxListingsPerBot` | `int` | `5` | live | The most auctions one bot has listed at once (0..50), counted from the auction house's own owner list; 0 lists nothing. |
| `World:Playerbots:Economy:MaxListingsPerHour` | `int` | `10` | live | The most auctions one bot lists in any 60 minutes of world time (0..100); 0 lists nothing. |
| `World:Playerbots:Economy:MoneyGoal` | `bool` | `true` | live | A bot short of money lists every visit and gets 3 more listing slots (on by default). Short means its budget reserves more than it has, or its money is below MoneyGoalCopperPerLevel times its level. It only raises listing, and never when ListChancePerVisit or MaxListingsPerBot is 0. |
| `World:Playerbots:Economy:MoneyGoalCopperPerLevel` | `int` | `500` | live | The money floor per character level of the money goal, in copper (0..100000); 0: only what the budget reserves counts. |
| `World:Playerbots:Economy:VisitIntervalMinutes` | `int` | `30` | live | Minutes between two visits of one bot (1..1440). Bots start at a random point of the first interval. |
| `World:Playerbots:Enabled` | `bool` | `false` | - | Run server-managed playerbots (off by default). |
| `World:Playerbots:FaultBackoffSeconds` | `int` | `30` | - | Seconds a bot waits in quarantine after an action fault before it is logged in again (1..3600); each further fault in `FaultWindowSeconds` doubles the wait, up to an hour. The bot stays desired meanwhile. |
| `World:Playerbots:FaultWindowSeconds` | `int` | `3600` | - | How far back faults count towards `MaxFaults`, in seconds of world time (1..604800). |
| `World:Playerbots:Follow:CatchUpMode` | `PlayerbotCatchUpMode` | `Teleport` | live | Teleport to catch up, fight through, or teleport only when unreachable (`PlayerbotCatchUpMode.Teleport` by default, the reference behaviour). Values: `Teleport`, `FightThrough`, `Auto`. |
| `World:Playerbots:Follow:DangerLevelMargin` | `int` | `3` | live | Teleport mode: a way that passes inside the aggro radius of a hostile creature this many levels or more above the bot, or of an elite at or above the bot's level, counts as no way (0..60). |
| `World:Playerbots:Follow:LeaderCombatRangeYards` | `float` | `50` | live | A bot in combat makes a catch-up teleport only when its leader is out of combat and farther than this many yards (the leader left the fight; vmangos counts a member's attacker within 50 yards as the group's fight, `SelectPartyAttackTarget`; 0..1000). |
| `World:Playerbots:Follow:MaxFallHealthPercent` | `int` | `50` | live | A drop to a leader below is taken when the fall (vmangos `Player::HandleFall` damage) would cost less than this percentage of the bot's current health (0: only falls that do no damage, under 14.57 yards; 0..99). |
| `World:Playerbots:Follow:MaxPathRatio` | `float` | `3` | live | Teleport mode: a way to the leader longer than this many times the straight distance counts as no way (1.5..20), when it is also at least `MinDetourYards` longer than the straight line. |
| `World:Playerbots:Follow:MinDetourYards` | `float` | `40` | live | Teleport mode: a way to the leader at most this many yards longer than the straight line is always walked (0..500). |
| `World:Playerbots:Follow:NoProgressSeconds` | `int` | `8` | live | Seconds without getting closer to a leader who stands still before the follower plans again; the same again after that re-plan and it teleports (Teleport and Auto modes) or plans once more (FightThrough). 2..120. |
| `World:Playerbots:Follow:TeleportDistanceYards` | `float` | `100` | live | Teleport mode: a leader on the bot's map farther than this many yards is teleported to (vmangos PartyBotAI `IsWithinDistInMap(pLeader, 100.0f)`; 10..1000). |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:Cooperation:AnswerBotCalls` | `bool` | `true` | live | Let a bot that hears another bot's LFG or LFM line for a goal it could join offer itself to that group (on by default). |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:Cooperation:GuildBonus` | `float` | `0.2` | live | The chance and the preference a guildmate of a group's member gains (0..1). |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:Cooperation:GuildCalls` | `bool` | `true` | live | Let a guild's bot say "anyone for the dungeon?" in guild chat while a group of the guild's members is forming for it, and let the guildmates who hear it join at once (on by default). The line is said only when such a group exists. |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:Cooperation:LfgAnswerBonus` | `float` | `0.15` | live | The chance a bot that answered another bot's LFG or LFM line gains (0..1). |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:Cooperation:MaxLfgAnswersPerLine` | `int` | `4` | live | The most bots that may answer one LFG or LFM line of another bot (1..64, default 4): once that many hold a place in the group, the rest of the hearers of the line are not weighed at all. |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:Cooperation:MaxRaidSize` | `int` | `40` | live | The most members a raid made from a risk signal recruits (6..40). |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:Cooperation:MentorAffinity` | `int` | `30` | live | The affinity a mentor needs toward the friend (-100..100). |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:Cooperation:MentorChance` | `float` | `0.3` | live | The chance, times the mentor's helpfulness trait, that a bot able to mentor does (0..1). |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:Cooperation:MentorLevelGap` | `int` | `10` | live | The levels a mentor must stand above the friend (1..60). |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:Cooperation:MentorMaxMinutes` | `int` | `20` | live | The longest, in minutes, a mentoring group lasts (1..240). |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:Cooperation:Mentoring` | `bool` | `true` | live | Let a bot far above a friend or guildmate that struggles with a quest group with it to clear the quest's objective (on by default). |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:Cooperation:RaidEscalation` | `bool` | `true` | live | Let a risk-signal group that needs more than five become a raid goal when enough bots are nearby (on by default). |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:Cooperation:Recruit` | `bool` | `true` | live | Let a waiting group recruit nearby bots that lack its goal (on by default). Off: only bots that share the goal are grouped. |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:Cooperation:RecruitBaseChance` | `float` | `0.35` | live | The base chance that a candidate accepts (0..1). The chance is this plus 0.4 times the candidate's sociability, plus 0.003 per point of its affinity toward the group's caller, plus 0.2 when the candidate fills a missing tank or healer, plus `GuildBonus` for a guildmate and `LfgAnswerBonus` for one that answered the call; at most 0.95. A rival and an affinity at or below `RefuseAffinity` never accept. |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:Cooperation:RecruitRadiusYards` | `int` | `300` | live | The farthest from the waiting bot, in yards, a recruit may stand (10..1500). |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:Cooperation:RecruitWaitSeconds` | `int` | `20` | live | Seconds a group of waiting bots stays short before it recruits (1..3600). |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:Cooperation:RefusalMemoryMinutes` | `int` | `10` | live | How long a candidate's refusal of a waiting group is remembered, in minutes (1..1440, default 10). The refusal is stored with its time: the candidate is not asked again until this long after it, and then rolls afresh (when the group is still waiting). The roll is made once per window of this length, with windows shifted by a phase hashed from the (candidate, group) pair, so different pairs do not all turn over together. |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:Cooperation:RefuseAffinity` | `int` | `-40` | live | A candidate whose affinity toward the group's caller is at or below this never joins (-100..0). |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:Cooperation:SameGoalMeetingRadiusYards` | `int` | `150` | live | How far from a dungeon's entrance (the group's meeting point), in yards, a player on the same continent still counts as on the dungeon goal of a bot that waits for a group (10..1500). A player inside the dungeon's instance always counts. Quest goals are unaffected. |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:DungeonRuns:BandAboveBoss` | `int` | `3` | live | Levels above the strongest boss the level band ends (0..20). |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:DungeonRuns:BandBelowBoss` | `int` | `3` | live | Levels below the weakest boss the level band starts (0..20): the band's lower end is the higher of the entrance level and the weakest boss's level minus this. |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:DungeonRuns:Enabled` | `bool` | `true` | live | Let free bots start dungeon runs (on by default). Off: no new run starts; running ones finish. Raid runs also need `PlayerbotRaidRunOptions.Enabled`. |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:DungeonRuns:LevelBandOverrides` | `Dictionary<string, string>` | `{}` | live | Level bands that replace the derived ones. Keys are a map id (`36`) or a map id and segment (`189:2`, the third wing of Scarlet Monastery, counting from 0); values `min-max` (1..63). Example: `"36": "15-22"`. |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:DungeonRuns:MaxConcurrentRuns` | `int` | `2` | live | The most dungeon runs at once (0..16; 0 starts none). |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:DungeonRuns:MaxRunMinutes` | `int` | `90` | live | The longest a dungeon run lasts, in minutes, from the moment the group forms (10..720). |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:DungeonRuns:MaxTravelYards` | `float` | `6000` | live | A bot farther than this from the entrance (yards, 3-D) is not matched for the run (500..20000). |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:DungeonRuns:MaxWipes` | `int` | `3` | live | Wipes a dungeon run survives; the run is given up at this many (1..20). |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:DungeonRuns:Raids:Enabled` | `bool` | `true` | live | Let free bots start raid runs (on by default; needs `PlayerbotRunOptions.Enabled` too). |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:DungeonRuns:Raids:HealerPercent` | `int` | `25` | live | Healers as a percentage of the raid (10..50): a raid of 40 takes 10 at 25. |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:DungeonRuns:Raids:MaxConcurrentRaids` | `int` | `1` | live | The most raid runs at once (0..4; 0 starts none). |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:DungeonRuns:Raids:MaxRunMinutes` | `int` | `240` | live | The longest a raid run lasts, in minutes, from the moment the raid forms (10..1440). |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:DungeonRuns:Raids:MaxWipes` | `int` | `5` | live | Wipes a raid run survives; the run is given up at this many (1..20). |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:DungeonRuns:Raids:SkipPrerequisites` | `bool` | `false` | live | Skip the raids' key item, attunement quest and condition requirements (off by default). On, bots are matched without them and the server lets the members of a bot raid run through the entrance without them. Only managed bots in a bot raid run, only through that raid's own entrance and never the entrance level: a real player, a bot outside a run and a dungeon run are checked as always. |

| `World:Playerbots:Groups:FormationTimeoutSeconds` | `int` | `300` | live | Seconds a bot waits for partners for one group goal (30..86400). With none by then, the goal is set aside and the bot goes on with what it can do alone; invitations not answered within this are given up too. |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:InvitePlayerAffinity` | `int` | `20` | live | The affinity toward a player that lets the bots invite it without an AI chat opt-in (-100..100). |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:InvitePlayerCooldownMinutes` | `int` | `30` | live | Minutes before the bots invite the same player again (0..1440). |

| `World:Playerbots:Groups:MinTank` | `int` | `1` | live | Tanks a group of three or more needs (0..5); warriors, druids and paladins can tank. |

| `World:Playerbots:Groups:WorldBosses:DeriveFromContent` | `bool` | `true` | live | Add every rank-3 creature on a continent that is no faction leader, flagged friendly or event placed to the catalogue (on by default). |

| `World:Playerbots:Groups:WorldBosses:LevelGap` | `int` | `2` | live | Levels below the lower of the boss's level and the player level cap that a bot may stand (0..20), so a level-60 bot qualifies for a level-63 boss at the default 2 (floor 58). |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:WorldBosses:MaxAttemptsPerDay` | `int` | `3` | live | The most raids per boss and UTC day that reached the walk to the boss (0..24; 0 opens none). A raid that never left the muster is not counted. |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:WorldBosses:MaxConcurrentRaids` | `int` | `1` | live | The most world-boss raids at once, server wide (0..8; 0 opens none). |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:WorldBosses:MaxRaidMinutes` | `int` | `90` | live | Minutes a raid may last from its formation (10..480). |
| `World:Playerbots:Groups:WorldBosses:MaxWipes` | `int` | `2` | live | Wipes the raid recovers from before it gives up (1..10). |

| `World:Playerbots:Groups:WorldBosses:RetrySeconds` | `int` | `1800` | live | Seconds before the same boss is mustered for again after a raid or a failed muster (60..86400). |

| `World:Playerbots:Groups:WorldBosses:WatchSeconds` | `int` | `30` | live | Seconds between looks at the catalogued bosses (5..600). |
| `World:Playerbots:Home:DangerLevelMargin` | `int` | `5` | live | Auto mode: the straight line from the bot to the centre crossing an area whose AreaTable level (`AreaLevel`, the 1.12.1 AreaTable.dbc exploration level) is more than this many levels above the bot's counts as unsafe, and the bot teleports (0..60). |
| `World:Playerbots:Home:ReturnMode` | `PlayerbotHomeReturnMode` | `Auto` | live | Walk, teleport, or teleport only when the walk is long or unsafe (`PlayerbotHomeReturnMode.Auto` by default). Values: `Walk`, `Teleport`, `Auto`. |
| `World:Playerbots:Home:TeleportDistanceYards` | `float` | `1500` | live | Auto mode: a bot on the home map farther than this many yards from the centre teleports instead of walking (100..20000). | `World:Playerbots:MaxActionsPerTick` | `int` | `48` | - | The most managed client actions all bots may send in one world tick (1..512). The tick's think time is bounded separately, by `ThinkBudgetMinMs`..`ThinkBudgetMaxMs` (`PlayerbotThinkBudget`): with about 1000 bots the action budget must not be the first limit a tick meets, or each bot waits more ticks for its share of actions and its movement lease runs out between thinks. |
| `World:Playerbots:MaxBots` | `int` | `8` | live | The most managed bots running at once (0..5000, `MaxBotsCeiling`). Only running bots take a slot: a stopped, faulted or quarantined bot does not, and a start beyond the cap is refused with "playerbot-capacity" (a quarantine retry or startup restore that finds no slot waits for one). Live through `.reload config`: raising it lets more bots start at once; lowering it below the running count stops nobody, it only refuses new starts until enough bots are stopped. |
| `World:Playerbots:MaxBulkCommand` | `int` | `50` | live | The most bots one bulk command (`.playerbot summon\|send\|start\|stop ... all` or a prefix) moves or starts without `force` (1..`MaxBotsCeiling`). A selection larger than this, with no smaller count, is refused. Live through `.reload config`. |
| `World:Playerbots:MaxDeliveryYards` | `float` | `1200` | - | Maximum same-map straight-line trip from a quest giver to its nearest present ender for an unhomed bot (0 disables the distance limit; 0..100000). |
| `World:Playerbots:MaxFaults` | `int` | `3` | - | The faults within `FaultWindowSeconds` that disable a bot for good (DesiredEnabled off; 1..100). |
| `World:Playerbots:MaxPathPoints` | `int` | `128` | - | The most points of one bot route (1..4096). |
| `World:Playerbots:MaxRegisteredBots` | `int` | `1000` | live | The most managed bots registered (running or not; 0..10000, `MaxRegisteredBotsCeiling`): `.playerbot create` is refused with "playerbot-registry-full" beyond it. | `World:Playerbots:MaxRouteYards` | `float` | `2000` | - | The longest bot route in yards (above 0, at most 100000). |
| `World:Playerbots:MaxThinkSearchNodes` | `int` | `98304` | live | The most navigation-mesh search nodes the fallback path queries of one bot think may create together (the steep escape, the starts beside the bot, the hazard detours; `PlayerbotThinkProbe.NodeBudget`): past it a fallback runs with what is left, or not at all, and finds nothing (its plan may then fail, as when no such way exists). A plan's own query is neither held to it nor counted. 0 = no bound, else 2048..10000000; three of the largest single searches (`PlayerbotNavigation.MaxSearchNodes`) by default. Live: `.reload config`. |
| `World:Playerbots:Mounts:Enabled` | `bool` | `true` | live | Let bots save for, train, buy and ride mounts (on by default). Off: no riding reserve, no trips, and a mounted bot is left as it is. |

On: the bot reports its motion with the MSG_MOVE_* packets a 1.12 client sends, dispatched through the ordinary movement handlers like any client's. Off: the server relocates the bot itself (the same locomotion observers) and sends its observers the same MSG_MOVE_* relay, skipping the opcode dispatch, the packet encode/decode and the handler, which is cheaper with many bots. Live: `.reload config` applies a change at once. |
| `World:Playerbots:Opportunities:Chests` | `bool` | `true` | live | Seek unlocked treasure chests, battered and solid chests and footlockers (on by default). |

| `World:Playerbots:Opportunities:MaxGuards` | `int` | `4` | live | The most guards a find may have (0..12; default 4): a larger pack is refused whatever it holds. 0 takes unguarded finds only. |
| `World:Playerbots:Opportunities:MinValue` | `float` | `0.75` | live | The least net reward worth a trip (0..20; default 0.75), in same-level kills: the find's loot and its guards' experience less the time to walk and fight. 1 is about what a same-level kill gives. |

| `World:Playerbots:Opportunities:PersonalityVariance` | `float` | `0.15` | live | How far a bot's own temperament moves `RiskAppetite` (0..0.5; default 0.15): each bot gets a stable factor from its guid between 1 minus and 1 plus this, so a crowd of bots does not take the same finds. |
| `World:Playerbots:Opportunities:Rares` | `bool` | `true` | live | Hunt rare creatures with loot worth the fight (on by default). |
| `World:Playerbots:Opportunities:RiskAppetite` | `float` | `1` | live | The aggressiveness knob for opportunities alone (0.25..4; default 1), applied on top of `Risk:Tolerance`: it scales the risk a bot accepts for the reward, as Tolerance does for a pull. 2 takes finds twice as dangerous, 0.5 only half. | `World:Playerbots:Opportunities:ScanRadiusYards` | `float` | `45` | live | How far (yards, 10..150; default 45) from the bot an opportunity may lie to be considered. |

| `World:Playerbots:Party:AutoRevive` | `bool` | `true` | - | Revive a dead bot in place when vmangos `PartyBotAI::ShouldAutoRevive` says so (on by default); otherwise it runs back. |
| `World:Playerbots:Party:InvitePolicy` | `PlayerbotInvitePolicy` | `Affinity` | - | Who may invite a bot (`PlayerbotInvitePolicy.Affinity` by default). Values: `None`, `GuildOrFriends`, `Anyone`, `Affinity`. |
| `World:Playerbots:Party:LootRoll` | `PlayerbotLootRoll` | `Need` | - | The vote on every group loot roll (`PlayerbotLootRoll.Need` by default: Need on upgrades, Greed otherwise). Values: `Pass`, `Greed`, `Need`. |
| `World:Playerbots:Party:MasterTimeoutSeconds` | `int` | `60` | - | Seconds a bot waits for an offline or departed master before it leaves the group and goes back to its own goals (1..3600). |
| `World:Playerbots:Party:TeleportToLeader` | `bool` | `true` | - | Teleport to the master when the follower cannot keep up by walking (vmangos PartyBotAI .goname; on by default). Off: the bot never teleports to its master, whatever `PlayerbotFollowOptions.CatchUpMode` says. |
| `World:Playerbots:PathJobSyncNodeThreshold` | `int` | `2048` | live | A path query of at most this many nodes stays on the world thread even with `PathJobs` (2048, vmangos' own budget, is a goal within about 100 yards; 0..32768). |
| `World:Playerbots:PathJobWaitMaxMs` | `int` | `30000` | live | How long one query may wait for its path job (wall ms) before it runs once on the world thread, held to `SyncPathQueryMaxMs` (1000..600000). |
| `World:Playerbots:PathJobWorkerMaxMs` | `int` | `1000` | live | The longest wall time in milliseconds a path job may hold a pool thread (a search past it ends as one that ran out of nodes; 10..60000). |
| `World:Playerbots:PathJobs` | `bool` | `false` | live | Whether a bot plan's far navigation-mesh search (more than `PathJobSyncNodeThreshold` nodes) runs on the shared path-job pool instead of the world thread: the bot answers "pending" for the think and the finished answer is applied on a later one, as it waits for a navigation tile still being read. A finished answer within 15% of the distance (10 to 40 yards) of a destination that keeps moving is applied as a route cut short, spliced from where the bot stands, and a refresh job for the new destination is queued in the same think. Off by default (rollout). Separately from this switch, and on whatever it says: a follower keeps walking its current route while a re-plan is pending (it also covers a navigation tile still being read). Live: `.reload config` (jobs in flight finish and are dropped or applied by the same checks). |
| `World:Playerbots:PathJobsMaxInFlight` | `int` | `64` | live | The most bot path jobs in flight together (1..1024); a bot past it waits in line, oldest first, and answers "pending" until a slot frees; one held that long still runs a single search on the world thread after `PathJobWaitMaxMs`, held to `SyncPathQueryMaxMs`. |
| `World:Playerbots:PathJobsMaxInFlightNodes` | `long` | `262144` | live | The most search nodes (the sum of the jobs' `MaxSearchNodes`) the bot path jobs in flight may hold together: it bounds pool time, not only the job count (4096..100000000). |

This is the master switch for `CornerClearanceYards`, `CornerCentringMaxYards` and `CornerTurnLeadYards`. |

| `World:Playerbots:Policy:StaleAfterMs` | `int` | `4500` | - | Scores taken from a snapshot older than this (world milliseconds) are not used: that think, the ladder decides (500..120000). |
| `World:Playerbots:Policy:Telemetry:Directory` | `string` | `"telemetry/playerbot-policy"` | - | The folder of the telemetry files: relative to the profile folder, or absolute. |
| `World:Playerbots:Policy:Telemetry:Enabled` | `bool` | `false` | - | Log each decision's state, choice and outcome (off by default). |
| `World:Playerbots:Policy:Telemetry:MaxFileBytes` | `long` | `16777216` | - | The largest one telemetry file grows before the next one starts, in bytes (64 KiB..1 GiB). |

| `World:Playerbots:Policy:Telemetry:OutcomeMinutes` | `int` | `5` | - | Minutes of world time a decision's outcome is measured over (1..60). |
| `World:Playerbots:Policy:TickBudgetMs` | `double` | `2` | - | Wall-clock milliseconds one map's batch may score for in one tick; the rows past it are left to the ladder and counted (0.1..50). |
| `World:Playerbots:Population:ActionLogSeconds` | `int` | `60` | live | The population logs one information line for the passes that parked, started, created or moved bots, at most once per this many seconds of world time; the changes of the passes in between are added up into the next line (0..3600; 0 = a line for every such pass). |
| `World:Playerbots:Population:AdoptOperatorHomes` | `bool` | `false` | live | Migration: the sweep also takes over the homes an operator set (any place text that is not the population's) for bots of the population, replacing them with the home of the bot's level (a level 1 bot with a stale Sentinel Hill home gets its start area). | `World:Playerbots:Population:AllianceSharePct` | `int` | `50` | live | With Factions Both, the share of new bots that are Alliance (0..100). |

| `World:Playerbots:Population:CapitalMajorSharePct` | `int` | `65` | live | The share in percent (0..100) of each faction whose master capital is its main one (Stormwind for the Alliance, Orgrimmar for the Horde); the rest go to the other two capitals, a bot's own race's first. |

| `World:Playerbots:Population:CapitalStayMinMinutes` | `int` | `5` | live | The shortest time in minutes (1..240) a bot stays at its capital (errands, then idling near the inn) before it heads back out. |

| `World:Playerbots:Population:ConfirmWindows` | `int` | `2` | live | The consecutive fresh windows of WindowTicks ticks the p95 must stay over TickP95BudgetMs before a park for the budget, or under ResumeBelowPct of it before an add (1..20). 1 acts on a single window.
